mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park tonight with a Waning Gibbous moon phase. If you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:14 AM tomorrow, traveling from the northwest near the high school toward the northeast near Home Depot. Expect an overnight low of 68 degrees with rain expected to move in.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to unite our community in fighting food insecurity. Additionally, September is recognized as Suicide Prevention Month to promote resources for mental health, and we are also honoring our building and code staff for their hard work keeping our city safe.

There is a lot going on this weekend! Tomorrow, you can check out the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena, or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to next week, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market on Tuesday.
For this week's police report, on August 19th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive where drivers were cited for various traffic violations.
Mint Explosion was today's feature, but since we are closed for the evening, you can grab tomorrow's flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough, when the store opens tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
